judgments.rationale: The proposal introduces a factual error in the summary by stating that the plan was in effect for a plan year beginning in 2008, whereas clause (ii)(I) explicitly requires the plan to have been in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007.

The proposed edit supplies the missing action and object for C0001 and accurately reflects the governing condition referenced in clause (ii), specifying that the single-employer plan must have been in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007 and had a positive balance in the funding standard account under section 1082(b) as of the end of that plan year.

P0001.rationale: The proposal introduces a factual error in the summary by stating that the plan was in effect for a plan year beginning in 2008, whereas clause (ii)(I) explicitly requires the plan to have been in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007.

source_spans.quote: In the case of a single-employer plan described in clause (ii), the plan sponsor may elect to maintain a funding standard carryover balance, until such balance is reduced to zero.

(ii) Plans maintaining funding standard account in 2007 A plan is described in this clause if the plan—

(I) was in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007, and

(II) had a positive balance in the funding standard account under section 1082(b) of this title as in effect for such plan year and determined as of the end of such plan year.
